name: Chop's Christmas Village
desc: A snowy ceramic Christmas village: cabins that grow into plastered, lit-up shops and houses with red, green and blue tiled roofs, wreath doors, picture windows, plus roads, parks and a Christmas market. Six residence designs, and Birch Meadow, Dark Forest, Mountain Stone, Hillside and Lakeside variants of the busiest huts. Needs Chop's Christmas Blocks (KubeJS).
